Ivy L: Heads-up — AuroraStack requested onboarding for Atlantic-2 (atl2). They want a hybrid marketplace + SI-managed region: dedicated baseline + burst pool, joint announcement target. Need marketplace SKU, quotas, SI integration (VectorOps), and KMS model.

Marcus G: Numbers and whether pinned hosts required? Any firm press date?

Omar (AuroraStack): POC is Omar. Target soft launch 2025-05-15 (announce if legal + infra ok). Quotas below.
- Dedicated GPU pool: 8 x H100-80GB (pinned)
- Burst pool: 16 x T4 (preemptible)
- vCPU: 1024
- RAM: 6TB
- Block storage: 120TB
- Floating IPs: 16
Marketplace SKU: aurorastack.atl2.hybrid
Entitlement tag: aurora-onboard-2025
Smoke tests: 1x H100 + 2x T4

Nina Q: VectorOps will handle autoscaling for burst — Evan what do you need?

Evan (VectorOps): Service account with role "inference-runner", webhook endpoint for job callbacks, and an encrypted secret for CI. We prefer partner-managed KMS for SOC reasons.

Ivy L: Redwood defaults to Redwood-managed KMS for marketplace SKUs. If partner-managed needed, security review + docs required. Priya, can legal/security weigh in?

Priya R: Need confirmation on data residency and PII processing. If partner-managed KMS, we need ATO checklist and liability language. I can draft joint announcement copy once infra says go.

Marcus G: Infra needs ASN/POP for peering, billing model for burst vs dedicated, and whether autoscaler will front burst pool.

Omar (AuroraStack): POP: LIN-BX1 (Barcelona). ASN: 65012. Burst autoscaled by VectorOps controller; AuroraStack covers burst egress. Billing: dedicated = committed invoice, burst = usage.

Ivy L: Owners/checklist:
- Quota/entitlement: Marcus G
- SI integration (service accounts/webhooks): Nina Q / Evan
- KMS decision & security review: Security + Priya R
- Marketplace listing & marketing copy: Nina Q
- Legal & announcement: Priya R
- Smoke-tests/CI artifacts: Omar / Evan

ops-bot: Jira INC-9022 created: "aurorastack atl2 hybrid marketplace + SI integration" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-9022

Marcus G: Filing cloud quota request now. ETA for smoke soft quota (1x H100 + 2x T4) ~72h. Full quota after security/KMS decision.

Nina Q: I'll start the marketplace draft and flag marketing for partner assets. Can we use partner logo day-1? Need brand kit.

Omar (AuroraStack): We will provide logos and a co-announcement paragraph. Fine to embargo until legal signoff. Uploading smoke container to the ticket.

Evan (VectorOps): Sending RBAC spec & webhook schema to INC-9022; will request a staging token for CI.

Priya R: I'll draft KMS addendum and joint announcement clause; expect initial comments in 48h.

Ivy L: Let's reconvene next Tue for go/no-go. Please add blockers to INC-9022. :rocket:
